integrity: Standalone analytic argument plus nonexhaustive code checks; no independent verification; references represent real publicly accessible research rather than proof of uniqueness.
scientific_limitations: Balanced alternating-star continuous-time deterministic NIMFA, equal rates and equal dwell times only; no finite-stochastic persistence conclusion or exact absolute endemic prevalence. title: Sharp switching-time threshold and phase contrast in balanced alternating-star SIS networks
